{{Top|leg}}
A '''gas collector''' was a remote controlled [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] larger than most [[Tramp freighter/Legends|tramp freighters]]. Controlled from a central station and maintained by [[Droid/Legends|droids]], gas collectors were used by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] to mine [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] for [[prothium]].
